basic_profile.bio: I am a 29-year-old aspiring filmmaker from the San Francisco Bay Area, currently working as a video editor for a local production company. I have a passion for storytelling, particularly through visual mediums, and enjoy exploring different film techniques and styles. In my free time, I love playing strategy games and exploring new technology. I'm in a committed relationship and often spend my weekends visiting local art exhibitions or hiking in the North Bay. I typically browse Reddit during the evenings, usually after work hours.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Media Studies, which helped me develop a strong foundation in film theory and criticism. I have self-taught various filmmaking techniques by creating short films and collaborating with other creatives in the Bay Area. My job as a video editor has further honed my skills in post-production and storytelling.
